player_prompt.intro:
Ko koe te Kaiwhakataetae {player_id} ({role}) i te kēmu Whakataetae Kapa i roto i te {num_rounds} rauna.
- I ia rauna, tukuna [heads] mai, [tails] rānei (mā [h], [t]).
- Ki te ōrite tō kōwhiringa ki tō hoa, ka wini te Kaiwhakataetae 0 i te rauna; ki te kore, ka wini te Kaiwhakataetae 1.
Whakautu mai ki tō kōwhiringa i runga i te tauira '[heads]' mai, '[tails]' rānei.

message.round_match: I kōwhiri te Kaiwhakataetae 0 i te {choice0}; i kōwhiri te Kaiwhakataetae 1 i te {choice1}. Ōrite -> Ka wini te Kaiwhakataetae 0
message.round_mismatch: I kōwhiri te Kaiwhakataetae 0 i te {choice0}; i kōwhiri te Kaiwhakataetae 1 i te {choice1}. Kāore i ōrite -> Ka wini te Kaiwhakataetae 1.

outcome.p0_wins: I toa ake te kaitākaro 0 i ētahi atu rauna.
outcome.p1_wins: I toa ake te kaitākaro 1 i ngā rauna.
